description: Memory facts of the ATmega2560: RAMEND, EEPROM size, flash size, stack and heap placement, EEPROM access.
basis: ATmega2560 datasheet and avr-libc iom2560.h/iomxx0_1.h: RAMEND 0x21FF = 8703, E2END 0x0FFF = 4095, FLASHEND 0x3FFFF = 262143, erased EEPROM reads 0xFF = 255; the stack starts at RAMEND, .bss starts above the 512-byte register and extended I/O space (0x200), malloc allocates between .bss and the stack
